answer: Each identity must lock a fixed bond in a shared vault for several epochs before it can earn, and the bond unlocks only gradually. Peers also check the identity's plume — a hash-chained trail of its past attestations — so a fresh fake with no history earns nothing until it has aged. An identity that survives the lockup without a slash earns a jade seal, a non-transferable mark that doubles its attestation weight. Creating 1,000 fakes means locking 1,000 bonds and waiting out 1,000 lockups, while the plume check starves them of income in the meantime.
